propositions: Retroactive commit linking must be exposed on CLI, library (rebar.attach_commits), and MCP surfaces with shared validation that rejects all-or-nothing on any invalid SHA

A deterministic close-gate check must block when discovered commits' changed paths are not covered by file_impact entries or exemption globs, with explicit handling for merge commits and git errors by source
Path matching uses **/−aware glob semantics unified in commit_impact.py, with prompts and registry delegating to the shared helper to avoid duplication
Source-ii (referencing) commits discovered locally fail closed on git errors, while source-i (COMMITS event) SHAs may be legitimately absent and are skipped
The close-gate check must union file_impact across the same ticket id set (ticket and transitive descendants) used by commit discovery to prevent false blocks on parent tickets with child-owned paths
Merge commits are explicitly skipped rather than read as empty path lists to prevent silent false passes on undeclared changes
